name: Pi Agent Web Exploration with Bright Data MCP
description: What makes Pi special is its flexibility, as you can shape its behavior, tools, and even UI. It supports multiple LLM providers, session trees, and customization primitives that make it closer to a programmable agent runtime than a fixed CLI assistant.
